name: Smart Full-Court Algebra
howToPlay: Read the problem, then solve it one line at a time. Tap Check! after every line. Stuck? Grab a hint or tap Show me how. For the real course, tap Learn it first.
footerNote: No sign-up, no passwords — just you, the numbers, and the work.
_themeNote: PLACEHOLDER colours — hardwood/orange/charcoal. Swap when the real brand colours arrive.

verses.text: Whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord…
Two are better than one, because they have a good reward for their labor.
The plans of the diligent surely lead to profit…
I can do all things through Christ, who strengthens me.
For God didn’t give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.

levels.name: Warm-Up Shots
levels.tagline: Two moves, in the right order.
levels.cheer: You scored 3 points on every possession, plus 8 from the line. You finished with 35. 🏀
levels.question: How many possessions did you score on?
hints: Undo the +8 before you touch the 3.

walkthrough.title: Undo the adding
walkthrough.body: Take 8 off both sides. The +8 goes and 35 becomes 27.

levels.name: Both Ends of the Floor
levels.cheer: Your points: 5 per game plus 12 already banked. Your rival: 3 per game plus 28. Tonight you tie. 🎯
levels.question: After how many games are you level?
hints: Get the x terms on one side — take 3x off both.

walkthrough.title: Then the numbers
walkthrough.body: Take 12 off both sides, then divide by 2.

levels.name: Set Play
levels.cheer: Four identical sets, each worth your score plus 6 bonus points. The whole run was worth 68. 📋
levels.question: What was your score in one set?
hints: Multiply the 4 by BOTH things inside: 4x + 24.

walkthrough.title: Expand
walkthrough.body: The 4 hits the x AND the 6.

levels.name: Reading the Line
levels.cheer: After 2 games you had 14 points. After 6 games you had 38. Your scoring is a straight line. 📈
levels.question: How many points per game is that?
hints: Slope is rise over run: change in points over change in games.

walkthrough.title: Rise over run
walkthrough.body: How far up, divided by how far across.

levels.name: Crunch Time
levels.tagline: A quadratic. Two answers, not one.
levels.cheer: The height of your shot in metres after t seconds is t² − 7t + 12 above the rim. It's level with the rim twice. 🏀
levels.question: At what times is it level with the rim? Give the SMALLER one.
hints: Factorise: two numbers that multiply to 12 and add to −7.
Either bracket can be zero: t = 3 or t = 4. The smaller is 3.

walkthrough.title: Factorise
walkthrough.body: Two numbers multiplying to 12 and adding to −7: −3 and −4.

walkthrough.title: Zero product
walkthrough.body: If two things multiply to zero, one of them is zero.
